{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
refunded_mask = data['status'] == 'refunded'
data_clean = data[~(qa_mask | refunded_mask)]

# Confirm no QA or refunded orders remain
print(f"Number of QA orders after filtering: {qa_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Number of refunded orders after filtering: {refunded_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Total rows after filtering: {len(data_clean)}")

# Cross-tabulate channel vs. customer_segment to check imbalance
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs. customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(data_clean['channel'], data_clean['customer_segment']))

# Compute conversion rates by channel
conv_rates = data_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
email_rate = conv_rates['email']
paid_search_rate = conv_rates['paid_search']

# Compute difference: email minus paid_search
effect = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Output results
print(f"\nConversion rate (email): {email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {paid_search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Effect (email - paid_search): {effect:.4f}")

# Store for submission
email_rate, paid_search_rate, effect"}
